# Visual report fixture credits

The photographic fixtures are resized and cropped by the CI report generator. The original works remain available from their source pages.

- `glacier-lake.jpg` — Lake McDonald, Glacier National Park. NPS Natural Resources / National Park Service. Public domain work of the U.S. federal government. [Wikimedia Commons source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:National_Park_Service_(48754075203).jpg).
- `blue-fox.jpg` — Blue fox on St. Paul Island. Ryan Mong / U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service. Public domain work of the U.S. federal government. [Wikimedia Commons source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Blue_fox_on_St_Paul_Island_by_Ryan_Mong_USFWS.jpg).

The synthetic mixed-content fixture is generated by the WIMF project and has no external source.
